title: Coconut Cove
meta_description: Coconut Cove: 4BR pet-friendly Prominence beach home with jacuzzi, fire pit, bikes, and resort-style pools near 30A's dining \& shopping.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Life is always breezy under a coconut tree and the vacation is always sweeter under the roof of Coconut Cove! This pet friendly 4 bedroom, 3.5 luxury beach house is located in the highly coveted Prominence neighborhood on 30A. This home has everything necessary to ensure that all guests are "happy little coconuts"; sonos audio system, smart TVs, quartz counter tops, a custom wet bar with wine cooler and beverage fridge, and gorgeous coastal furnishings. With room to comfortably sleep up to 12 guests, crisp, white linens in every bedroom, and plenty of natural light allowing the sun to shine on the cheerful decor. Out back you'll enjoy the privacy of a preserve behind the large Trex deck with a 6-person Jacuzzi tub, a fire pit with plenty of cozy furniture, fairy lights to set the scene, and a Saber 6 burner grill.

ABOUT THE AREA: Prominence South is a charming coastal community nestled between Seagrove Beach and Alys Beach and just 20 minutes to Pier Park. The community features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Residents will enjoy easy access to a beautiful town center, 5,000 square foot resort style pool In the heart of Prominence is The Big Chill (formerly the Hub), a family hot spot for dining, shopping and entertainment, featuring an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen which streams major sporting events, movies as well as features live music on their very own stage.

BEACH ACCESS:
Deer Lake State Park: This state park is roughly 1/2 mile from Prominence. There is an entry fee of $3 per vehicle (2 to 8 passengers) or $2 per pedestrian, bicyclist, and extra passengers. There is a long scenic boardwalk that brings you from the parking lot to the beach and is a five-to-ten minute walk. Beach service is not provided here.

Walton Dunes: located 2.5 miles from the Prominence area, Walton Dunes is an easily accessible beach entrance! Unlike Deer Lake, there are no stairs/ramps and you can walk right up to the beach. You take a left at Lakewood Drive and follow the curve until you see the parking lot for cars. Beach service is the only amenity provided.

Santa Clara: located 3.5 miles away and is ADA accessible, has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located on Scenic 30A, 1/2 mile east of Scenic 395, turn south on Bramble Grove Place.

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 12
• Bedroom 1 -- King, Ensuite (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 2 -- Queen, Ensuite (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 3 -- Queen, shared hallway bath (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 4 -- (2) Twin/Full beds (2nd Floor)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Pet Friendly ($250/dog NRF)
• Premium six person Jacuzzi
• Saber outdoor lounge area with fire pit and fairy lights
• 2 Complimentary Bikes
• Garage/driveway parking
• 2 Community pools with cabanas, \& grills
• Smart TV's in every room
• Wet Bar with wine/drink fridge and ice maker
• Full size Washer \& Dryer
• Full linen package
• Fully stocked kitchen

\*\*\*PET FRIENDLY\*\*\*

\*\*\* PROMINENCE POOL NOW HEATED October \& November AND March \& April

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces with overflow parking available in the south-side gravel area.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
